defect.reported_by_main: AckermannParameters(speed_response_s=0.0001) with defaults; 2000 x step(throttle=1, steering=0, dt_s=0.001) reached max speed 5.0010000000000785 above the declared max_speed 5
defect.mechanism: explicit Euler response a = clamp((target-speed)/tau, +/-a_max), following = speed + a*dt crosses the current target whenever dt > tau (or when the clamped increment exceeds the remaining gap)

fix.shape: hold following_speed on the current target when the explicit step would cross it, and report the realised increment as acceleration
fix.bounded_approach: speed after each step stays within [min(speed,target), max(speed,target)]
fix.max_acceleration_preserved: crossing implies |target-speed| < |a|*dt, so the rewritten realised increment |target-speed|/dt is strictly below the clamped |a| <= a_max
fix.specific_force_matches_realised_incremen: acceleration is rewritten as (following_speed-self.speed)/dt_s in the crossing branch and remains the value returned in specific_force_frd_m_s2[0]
fix.default_parameter_path_unchanged: with tau=0.25 and the 0<dt_s<=.02 contract, dt/tau <= 0.08 < 1, so following never crosses the target and the new comparisons are both false; statement order, operators and types are otherwise unchanged
fix.no_new_rejection: no speed_response_s floor and no dt/tau constraint was added; __post_init__ still has exactly two Raise sites
